{{Quote|You may know that I'm a spy, but you won't live to tell anyone!|Major Barret Herand, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IS" />}}
'''Barret Herand''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]] posted to the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]]. Herand was secretly working with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and committed various acts of sabotage around the retreat, until he was tracked down and killed during the operation.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCorporalTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Major Barret Herand]]
Barret Herand was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Barret Herand was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:IS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
